metadata.note: Day 36. FINAL DRAFT 001 - the whole piece in one file: Section 1 (2-135 s), the three morph sections BLOOM/CONVERGENCE/BALANCE (141-495 s) and the trance (500-751 s). 4481 notes in 24 groups, 2.00-751.42 s. Froze piece-s28 as the era in which the trance section was notated (the per-part tempo apparatus) and folded into MAIN DRAFT, which now reads 0-751 s.
